title: Disc Brake
text: Rotational brake with disc, drum, mapped, or external torque modes, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Brake pad mean radius, Rm} sets Radius; {Brake type}, {Rotation type}, {Output Info bus} sets the option to output Info bus, {Wheel inertia, Iyy} sets the wheel inertia scalar, {Axle viscous damping coefficient, br} sets the axle viscous damping, {Wheel initial angular velocity, omegao} sets the wheel initial angular, {Static friction coefficient, mu_static}, {Kinetic friction coefficient, mu_kinetic}, {Disc brake actuator bore, disc_abore} sets the bore distance, {Number of brake pads, num_pads}, {Drum brake actuator bore, drum_abore} sets the bore distance, {Shoe pin to drum center distance, drum_a}, {Shoe pin center to force application point distance, drum_c}, {Drum internal radius, drum_r}, {Shoe pin to pad start angle, drum_theta1}, {Shoe pin to pad end angle, drum_theta2}, {Brake actuator pressure breakpoints, brake_p_bpt} sets the brake actuator pressure, {Wheel speed breakpoints, brake_n_bpt} sets the wheel speed breakpoints vector and {Brake torque map, f_brake_t} sets the lookup table for brake. Values come from the instance.
